name: Lakshmi Mills Company Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1910, The Lakshmi Mills Company Ltd manufactures Yarn and trades in cloth & garments, and also 
rents out properties[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
LMC manufactures cotton yarn and polyester-blended yarn. Employing 2000+ people, it produces yarn in the count range of 60s to 100s.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.65 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 3.79% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -1.22% over last 3 years.
